Located within the Wall/Gates complex, The Fresh Plate is a brand new All-You-Care to Eat dining spot that promises to push your Dining Bucks the extra mile. It's tailor-made for Red Raiders, offering an incredible dining experience at an unbeatable value.

You can look forward to a dynamic culinary adventure at The Fresh Plate where you'll never get bored of the delicious choices. During the week, you'll find a variety of traditional mealtimes to satisfy your cravings, while on the weekends, a delightful brunch awaits you.

Prepare your taste buds for an array of mouthwatering options! Indulge in hamburgers, savory pizzas, flavorful Mexican entrées, delectable hot sandwiches, and a selection of international dishes that will transport your palate around the world. You can also savor homestyle favorites, fresh salads from the salad bar, a fruit bar, and an irresistible assortment of desserts to indulge your sweet tooth.

The Fresh Plate at Wall/Gates also has a convenient retail option available. Red Raiders can grab a quick bite without any hassle, whether you're rushing to class, or crave a snack. The Fresh Plate at Wall/Gates accepts Dining Bucks, checks, and credit cards.
